title: setRoute validates swap_type as a denylist {0, 9} instead of Router NG v1.1's allowlist {1..8}; an out-of-range swap_type is stored and reverts every swap, freezing the market strategy's deposit/withdraw/skim until overwritten

faithfulnessCrossRef.note: Code follows step 7 to the letter ('swap_type != 0 and != 9'); the story under-enumerates Router NG's rejected set relative to its own goal ('only store routes where the router actually delivers tokenOut'). One ledger entry, carried as the spec-conformance face of this finding; recommend amending story-052 to an allowlist.

description: The executed-row swap_type check at CurveAMMAdapter.sol:124-127 is `!= 0 && != 9` rather than `1 <= st <= 8`. Router NG v1.1 dispatches only 1..8, so swap_type 10..type(uint256).max is accepted and stored, and every subsequent swap reverts until the owner overwrites the route. The NatSpec (:91-92; ICurveRouterNG.sol:19-20) inherits the story's wording and reads as if swap_type validity is enforced.
impact: No asset loss. Owner-authored, fail-loud on the first swap, recoverable by overwrite (no clearRoute lock-in): availability freeze of the market strategy's deposit/withdraw/skim while the bad route is stored.
attackPath: The owner sets a route with an out-of-range swap_type, trusting the validator.
The first swap reverts in Router NG.
evidence: Invariant P1 RESIDUAL_swapTypeInRange FAIL (expected) on forge+medusa (reports/18/tier3-raw/forge-route-invariant.txt).
priorOwnerTriage: sya-harvester run-02 L-05 (sh2l5 / 3dc3002290, swap_type >= 9) owner-rated QA on 2026-10-26 — direct analogue.
recommendation: if (swapType == 0 || swapType > 8) revert InvalidRouteSwapParams(h);  — avoid the `st - 1 >= 8` idiom (panics 0x11 on 0). Amend story-052 step 7 to an allowlist.
escalationTrigger: LOW if an out-of-range swap_type is ever stored on a live adapter with clients unable to exit during the overwrite window (cf. L-30: the live adapter has the older validator).
disclose: L-07 b28e77daefb3 (sibling setRoute validation gap; different root/fix)
